CIViC Description: Two TERT promotor mutations -124 (C228T, most common) and -146 (C250T) occur in up to 83% of primary glioblastomas, 71% of melanomas, 66% of urothelial carcinomas of the bladder, 47% of hapatocellular carcinomas, 21% of medulloblastomas and up to 40% of thyroid cancers. These promoter mutations reactivate TERT expression by recruitment of the GABP transcription factor.
